_comment: Tier-2: wall nodal forces stay identically zero unless COMPUTE_FEM_RESULTS_OPTION is enabled — without it ComputeDEMFaceLoadUtility transfers nothing, silently. Pitfall (kratos.dem_structures_coupling #3). Executed on Kratos 10.4.3 (pip wheels, glibc-2.31 host, fresh venv on external ext4 image). The flag resolves on DEMApplication and not on core. DEM_SURFACE_LOAD, the quantity that stays zero, is on DemStructuresCouplingApplication — a THIRD module, neither core nor DEM — so a reader chasing the silent zero has two chances to dot the wrong module before reaching the flag. The fixture imports KratosMultiphysics at module scope; with Kratos absent the import raises, the process exits non-zero and the runner records a failure, never a pass.
